verdict.rationale: Snyk documents multiple concrete auto-fix mechanisms beyond report-reading: actionable fix advice with automated PRs for OSS deps, a dedicated Remediation Agent that generates and applies fixes with verification (`snyk fix --agentic`, `/snyk-fix`, `/snyk-batch-fix`), and DeepCode AI-powered autofixes with claimed 85% accuracy. These are first-party documented workflows going beyond passive reporting. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that suggested fixes actually apply cleanly (community evidence instead criticizes related PR-automation quality for dependency updates), and no third-party corroboration of the Remediation Agent's real-world fix success rate.
